body:
The server can list a workspace's designs and return one, so the page and agents have one way to read them. Nothing writes a design yet.

### Do

- Decide where the current designs live in the repo and record it in the format decision. They belong to the workspace, not to a project. They can't sit in `.solace/`, because git ignores it apart from `store.db` and `approved`. A cursory suggestion: `designs/<id>.json` at the root.
- Give a design an ID the way tasks get theirs.
- Add root routes in the board server: `GET /designs` returns each design's ID, title and tab; `GET /designs/{id}` returns one design whole.
- A file that fails validation is reported rather than breaking the list. A missing design returns the usual not-found error (`E7023`).
- Add the routes to Spec 15.

### Acceptance

- Tests: an empty workspace lists nothing, two designs on different tabs both list, one design reads back whole, a missing ID gives `E7023`, and an invalid file doesn't hide the valid ones.
- Works when the workspace root isn't itself a project (see `board::server.root_route`).

### Left out

Saving, versions, and any page.
title: design: list and read designs
